desc:
[UPDATE] Overlord, Honkai, & more added!

🖌️Collect and paint beautiful high quality anime girls one color at a time using relaxing paint-by-number gameplay! 

🩷 Paint adorable anime girls
🖼️ Display your finished paintings encased in cute frames
💰 Earn cash from visitors and tips
👥 Invite friends to visit and rate your collection
🎀 Relax with satisfying and cozy gameplay

🔥 Leave a like and join the group for suggestions!
💾 Progress saves automatically

🌸 Current Anime in the game: One Piece, Genshin Impact, Demon Slayer, Chainsaw Man, Akame Ga Kill, Attack On Titan, Bleach, Classroom of the Elite, Darling in the Franxx, Death Note, Dress Up Darling, Eighty Six, Eminence in Shadow, Fairy Tail, Fate Stay Night, Frieren, Jujutsu Kaisen, Konosuba, League of Legends, Mushoku Tensei, Madoka Magica, MHA, Naruto Shippuden, Oshi No Ko, Quintessential Quintuplets, Re:Zero, That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime, Spy x Family, Sword Art Online, Wuthering Waves and so many more!
